summary: Lumen Technologies and its wholly-owned subsidiary Qwest Corporation filed an 8-K announcing the expiration and final results of exchange offers and consent solicitations. Qwest offered to exchange its 6.5% Notes due 2056 and 6.75% Notes due 2057 for new 6.500% Notes due 2051 and 6.750% Notes due 2052, respectively. The offers expired June 9, 2026. No specific price per share, premium, or advisor is mentioned. The exchange used consideration type 'other' (notes for notes). Watch for the reduction of debt maturity or extension profile and any subsequent amendments to indentures, impacting credit metrics.
